definitions.explanation: A written or printed representation of music using musical notation; the physical sheets or document containing the notes to be performed.

examples.japanese: {譜面|ふめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}した→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧。
examples.english: I played while reading the sheet music.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{譜面|ふめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っています→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have the sheet music for this piece?

examples.japanese: ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏家|えんそうか}→演奏家：29184_ensouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{譜面|ふめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}なくて→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}ける→弾く：02444_hiku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Professional musicians can often play without looking at the sheet music.

notes:
USAGE:
{譜面|ふめん} is commonly used among musicians and in music education. It refers to the physical document or display of musical notation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {譜面|ふめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read sheet music)
- {譜面|ふめん}{台|だい} (music stand)
- {譜面|ふめん}{通|どお}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ (to play exactly as written)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {譜面|ふめん}: the physical score/sheet music (practical, musician's term)
- ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧: musical score (slightly more formal/general)
- ⟦スコア→スコア：28557_sukoa⟧: full orchestral score (from English "score")
